in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word χάρτης (chartes) which means 'paper, leaf, writing tablet' and the suffix -ιλλος (-illos) which means 'man of, son of'

in_latin.name: Hartillus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'hartus' or 'hardus' which means 'hard, strong'
